Sorolan Base64 Kooderin tietosuojakäytäntö

Voimaantulopäivä: Elokuu 2026

1. Introduction

Sorolan Base64 Kooderi ("työkalu") on 100 % paikallinen Base64-kooderi ja -dekooderi, joka on sitoutunut täydelliseen yksityisyyteen. Tämä tietosuojakäytäntö kertoo, miten työkalu käsittelee tietoja.

2. Data Collection and Usage

The Tool runs entirely in your browser. All encoding and decoding happens locally on your device — no data is ever sent to any server.

  • No Tracking: The Tool does not track your browsing history, monitor your behavior, or collect any analytics.
  • No Data Retention: The text you enter is never saved, logged, or transmitted anywhere.
  • Fully Offline: The Tool works without an internet connection after the page has loaded.

3. Data Sharing and Third Parties

We do not sell, share, or rent any data to third parties. The Tool contains no tracking codes, analytics, or advertisements, and it does not communicate with any external APIs or servers.

4. Security

Since all processing happens locally in your browser and no data leaves your device, your text remains completely private and secure.

5. Contact

If you have any questions regarding this privacy policy, you can contact us at: contact.make@sorola.fi
